facts.section: Ruralz Control REST and gRPC APIs
facts.value: Ruralz Control serves the REST API and Ruralz Console on 8090, the Control Stream on 8091 (never used by the CLI) and the peer layer on 8092
published as OpenAPI and additive within `v1`
REST API on 8090: Everything is Planned (M2).
`/api/v1/promotions`, `/api/v1/promotions/{id}` with `/approve`, `/reject`, `/retry` GET, POST; write role: `approver`; retry: `operator`
`/api/v1/revisions/{digest}/resources`, `/api/v1/revisions/{digest}/resources/{kind}/{name}` GET (proposed, OQ-cli-and-api-surface-3); write role: Read only
`/api/v1/rollouts`, `/api/v1/rollouts/{id}` with `/pause`, `/resume`, `/rollback`, `/approve`, `/reject` GET, POST; write role: `operator`; approve: `approver` with step-up
`/api/v1/enrollment-tokens` POST; write role: `security-admin`, or a Cluster-scoped API token
`/api/v1/trust` GET, POST; write role: `admin`; anchor sets: `security-admin`
`/api/v1/audit` GET; write role: `auditor`, also for reads
`/api/v1/access` GET, POST, DELETE; write role: `admin`, also for reads
`/api/v1/backup` GET, POST; write role: `admin`, also for reads
The ten Configuration model kinds map onto these resources; Git stays the source of truth (P5): no path edits Bundle resources.
Revision: Built from Git, a push or CRDs; never uploaded pre-rendered
Errors are RFC 9457 problem documents with `requestId` and an `RZ-CP` or `RZ-CFG` `code`.
Digests in paths and bodies are full `sha256:<64 hex>` values; only `digestPrefix` takes 12 hex characters.
Unknown request fields are rejected: RZ-CFG-006 for Bundle fields, else 400 (code: OQ-cli-and-api-surface-12).
Collections list newest first, with a `next` cursor; Rollout, promotion and Node IDs are ULIDs.
a snapshot plus delta protocol with xDS-style ACK/NACK, not xDS (ADR-0007)
built with connect in gRPC mode on both ends
a regional relay serves the same service, Planned (M4)
`EnrollResponse` (certificate chain, server CA, trust root, anchor set, Cluster, Environment)
8092 is not public: it admits only replicas, relays (Planned (M4)) and the token `Join` of `ruralz control join`, authorizing by certificate role and rejecting Node certificates
The `postgres` Control Store, Planned (M4), leaves it unused.
Every surface denies by default; only `/healthz` and `/readyz` MAY be open (pack section 8.4)
Admin `/metrics`: Metrics or operator token, or client certificate, on every interface including loopback; On failure 401
Admin `/debug/*`, `/config/dump`, `/tap`: Operator token or client certificate; off without an operator token; On failure 401
REST API: Session cookie (Ruralz Console) or API token, TLS 1.3 by default
step-up TOTP for approvals, reverts, trust uploads and Access changes
401 for failed authentication (code: OQ-cli-and-api-surface-12); `RZ-CP-007` for RBAC or separation-of-duties denials; audited
One-time token, pinned server CA (pack 8.4 amendment proposed: OQ-security-and-identity-31)
Per-Node certificate (mTLS), the only source of `node.id`
Peer layer: On failure Connection refused
one-time `admin` token for `Join` (pack 8.4 amendment proposed: OQ-control-plane-and-gitops-15, OQ-security-and-identity-31)
Admin credentials are Node process settings, never Bundle fields.
Security and identity decided OQ-system-overview-6 (admin ports bind all interfaces for kubelet probes)
Tokens are compared in constant time, accepted only over TLS or loopback
the CLI sends `--admin-token-file` as a bearer token, never in cleartext beyond loopback, or presents `--client-cert` and `--client-key`
Ruralz Console uses local accounts, TOTP and same-site, CSRF-protected session cookies, Planned (M2)
OIDC and SAML SSO is Planned (M5), in the one build (P1)
The CLI and CI send scoped, expiring API tokens an `admin` issues under Access.
Approvers never approve a change they authored, committed, wrote back, pushed, started or requested, and nobody edits their own bindings.
On step-up the CLI prompts for TOTP on a terminal, else exits 2 (OQ-cli-and-api-surface-5).
`ruralz node token` mints the one-time token, stored hashed, embedding fingerprints that pin the first dial
`ruralz node revoke` closes the stream and refuses renewal
Data goes to standard output; progress, warnings and prompts to standard error. Timestamps are RFC 3339 UTC.
Human output shows Revisions as `rev-<12 hex>`; JSON always carries the full `sha256:<64 hex>` digest.
`ruralz bundle validate` default: One diagnostic per line: `file:line:column severity code Kind/name path: message`; json: Array of Configuration model diagnostics; `[]` when clean
`ruralz bundle render` default output: YAML (`--output yaml`); a table with `--effective`; files with `--api-version`
`ruralz test run`, `ruralz plugin test` json: Cases with `name`, `passed`, `failures`; `ruralz test run --bundle` adds `revision` and `testDigest`
`ruralz ai cost` json: Rows with `currency` and `approximate`
`ruralz bundle export` default: OpenAPI 3.x YAML, Postman JSON or DOT text; json: OpenAPI as JSON
`ruralz ai cost` default: Table per currency; also `--output csv`
`ruralz plugin inspect`, commands reading REST default: Tables
The `ruralz version` members take OQ-release-versioning-and-compatibility-6 option (a).
This document owns compatibility of `ruralz.diff.v1`: changes are additive only, and consumers MUST ignore unknown members.
Field operations stay `add`, `remove`, `replace` and `move`, with zero-based positions; a changed meaning needs `ruralz.diff.v2`.
First addition: `from` and `to` gain `digest`, the full `sha256:<64 hex>` beside `revision`
Exit codes never change once released.
`ruralz bundle diff` keeps the Configuration model rule (0 no changes, 1 changes, 2 errors)
2: Usage error, unreadable input or diff source, unresolved `rev-<12 hex>`, authentication or RBAC denial, `RZ-CP` error, missing step-up
2: `--wait` timeout, unsupported platform, local `ruralzd` not ready, no verified lock holder
1: `manual` items from `bundle import krakend`; `plugin build` compile error; `--api-version` conversion that changed a Revision
An invalid Bundle is 1 for `validate`, `render`, `build` and `audit`, whose result is validity, and 2 for `diff`, whose result is a difference.
Warnings never change the code; with `--output json`, server errors print their problem document.
